name: Money Market Secured Market Statistical Report V 02
definition: The MoneyMarketSecuredMarketStatisticalReport message is sent by the reporting agents to the relevant competent authority, to report all relevant secured money market transactions.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Provides the elements specific to the report.

SecuredMarketReport.name: Secured Market Report
SecuredMarketReport.definition: Provides the reason why no activity is reported or the required list of transactions for the secured market segment.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
